Script.name: Achaea workspace link controller
Script.script:
-- Independent controller: never embed this in either module it reloads. -- Workspace XMLs are read-only inputs; Mudlet owns only profile-local copies. YsoWorkspaceLink=YsoWorkspaceLink or {} local R=YsoWorkspaceLink if R.busy then return R end R.root=R.root or 'C:/Users/shuji/OneDrive/Desktop/Yso systems' R.handlers=R.handlers or {};R.watches=R.watches or {};R.timers=R.timers or {} R.generation=(R.generation or 0)+1 R.sequence=R.sequence or 0 local generation=R.generation local names={'AK','Yso system'} local function normalize(p) return tostring(p or ''):gsub('\','/'):gsub('/+$',''):lower() end local function home() return getMudletHomeDir():gsub('\','/'):gsub('/+$','')..'/yso-workspace' end local function source(name) return R.root..'/Ysindrolir/mudlet packages/'..name..'.xml' end local function staged(name) return home()..'/modules/'..name..'.xml' end local function applied(name) return home()..'/modules/'..name..'.applied.xml' end local function published(name,suffix) return R.root..'/Ysindrolir/.workspace-link-publish/'..name..suffix end local function say(s) if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<steel_blue>[Yso workspace] <reset>'..s..'
') end end local function read(path) local f=io.open(path,'rb');if not f then return nil end local s=f:read('*a');f:close();return s end local function write(path,data) local f,e=io.open(path,'wb');if not f then return false,e end local ok,why=f:write(data);local closed,close_error=f:close() if not ok or not closed then return false,why or close_error or 'write_failed' end return true end local function contains(t,name) if type(t)~='table' then return false end if t[name] then return true end for _,v in ipairs(t) do if v==name then return true end end return false end local function valid_xml(s) return type(s)=='string' and s:find('<MudletPackage[%s>]')~=nil and s:match('</MudletPackage>%s*$')~=nil end local function validation_receipt(name,bytes) local receipt=read(published(name,'.validated')) if not receipt then return nil end local ending=receipt:find('
',1,true) if not ending or not receipt:sub(1,ending-1):match('^%d+$') then return nil end local length=tonumber(receipt:sub(1,ending-1)) if length~=#bytes or receipt:sub(ending+1,ending+length)~=bytes then return nil end return receipt:sub(ending+length+1) end local function valid_lua_metadata(name,data) local pos=1;local compiler=loadstring or load while pos<=#data do local ending=data:find('
',pos,true) if not ending then return false end local digits=data:sub(pos,ending-1) if not digits:match('^%d+$') then return false end local length=tonumber(digits) if not length or length>#data-ending then return false end local body=data:sub(ending+1,ending+length) if not compiler(body,name..':workspace preflight') then return false end pos=ending+length+1 end return true end local function cancel(key) if R.timers[key] and type(killTimer)=='function' then pcall(killTimer,R.timers[key]) end R.timers[key]=nil end local function later(key,seconds,fn) cancel(key) R.timers[key]=tempTimer(seconds,function() if R.generation~=generation then return end R.timers[key]=nil;fn() end) end local function resolve(namespace) local value=_G for part in tostring(namespace or ''):gmatch('[^.]+') do if type(value)~='table' then return nil end value=value[part] end return value end function R.idle() if type(getProfileName)~='function' or getProfileName()~='Achaea' then return false,'wrong_profile' end if type(Yso)~='table' or type(Yso.mode)~='table' then return false,'yso_unavailable' end if type(Yso.is_actively_fighting)=='function' and Yso.is_actively_fighting() then return false,'automation_active' end if type(Yso.mode.active_route_id)=='function' then local id=Yso.mode.active_route_id() if id and id~='' and id~='none' then return false,'automation_active' end end local RR=Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.RouteRegistry if not (RR and type(RR.active_ids)=='function') then return false,'route_registry_unavailable' end for _,id in ipairs(RR.active_ids()) do local entry=RR.resolve and RR.resolve(id) local route=entry and resolve(entry.namespace) if type(route)=='table' and type(route.state)=='table' then local pending=route.state.pending local waiting=(type(pending)=='table' and next(pending)~=nil) or (pending~=nil and pending~=false and type(pending)~='table') if route.state.loop_enabled==true or waiting then return false,'automation_active' end end end if Legacy and Legacy.Settings and Legacy.Settings.Basher and Legacy.Settings.Basher.status==true then return false,'automation_active' end local Q=Yso.queue if Q then for _,lane in ipairs({'bal','eq','class','free'}) do local p=type(Q.list)=='function' and Q.list(lane) if (type(p)=='string' and p~='') or (type(p)=='table' and next(p)~=nil) then return false,'commands_staged' end if type(Q.get_owned)=='function' and Q.get_owned(lane) then return false,'commands_queued' end end end return true end local function preflight(link) local ok,why=R.idle();if not ok then return nil,why end for _,api in ipairs({'getPackages','getModules','getModulePath','installModule','reloadModule', 'setModulePriority','disableModuleSync','tempTimer','registerAnonymousEventHandler'}) do if type(_G[api])~='function' then return nil,'missing_api:'..api end end if link and (type(saveProfile)~='function' or type(uninstallPackage)~='function') then return nil,'migration_api_unavailable' end local jobs={} for i,name in ipairs(names) do local bytes=read(source(name)) if not valid_xml(bytes) then return nil,'invalid_xml:'..name end -- The publisher uses a real XML parser. Byte-exact snapshots bind its -- extracted Lua metadata to these inputs, including malformed mid-save edits. local metadata=validation_receipt(name,bytes) if metadata==nil then return nil,'unpublished_xml:'..name end if not valid_lua_metadata(name,metadata) then return nil,'invalid_lua:'..name end local mod=contains(getModules(),name) local pkg=contains(getPackages(),name) if mod and pkg then return nil,'ambiguous_install:'..name end if mod and normalize(getModulePath(name))~=normalize(staged(name)) then return nil,'unmanaged_module:'..name end if not link and not mod then return nil,'not_linked:'..name end jobs[i]={name=name,bytes=bytes,was_module=mod,was_package=pkg, previous=read(staged(name)),priority=i-1} end return jobs end local function guard_routes() local M=Yso and Yso.mode if not M or type(M.start_route_loop)~='function' or M.start_route_loop==R.guarded_start then return end local original=M.start_route_loop R.guarded_start=function(...) if R.busy then return false,'workspace_reload' end return original(...) end M.start_route_loop=R.guarded_start end local function hold_offense() Yso.pause=Yso.pause or {};Yso.pause.offense=Yso.pause.offense or {} R.previous_pause={active=Yso.pause.offense.active==true,reason=Yso.pause.offense.reason} Yso.pause.offense.active=true;Yso.pause.offense.reason='workspace_reload' guard_routes() end function R.status(echo) local rows,changed={},false for _,name in ipairs(names) do local linked=type(getModulePath)=='function' and normalize(getModulePath(name))==normalize(staged(name)) local bytes=read(source(name));local different=bytes~=read(applied(name)) rows[#rows+1]={name=name,linked=linked,changed=different,source=source(name),module=staged(name)} changed=changed or different end local result={busy=R.busy==true,changed=changed,modules=rows,last_error=R.last_error} if echo~=false then for _,row in ipairs(rows) do say(row.name..': '..(row.linked and 'linked' or 'not linked')..', '..(row.changed and 'workspace update pending' or 'up to date')) end if R.busy then say('Update in progress.') end if R.last_error then say('Last update failed: '..R.last_error) end end return result end local function fail(reason) cancel('operation');cancel('timeout') local job=R.current -- Restore only the failed module's on-disk input. Successfully reloaded peers -- stay current; never claim an atomic rollback of live Lua globals. if job and job.was_module and job.previous then write(staged(job.name),job.previous) end R.busy=false;R.current=nil;R.last_error=tostring(reason);R.last_result='failed' say('Update stopped: '..R.last_error..'. A partial update is possible; automation stays stopped.') say('Offense remains paused; correct the update before resuming.') if R.backup_path then say('Profile backup: '..R.backup_path) end end local next_job local function rearm_runtime() -- A full package-to-module conversion may remove native-owned anonymous -- handlers while leaving Lua globals and their install-once flags alive. for _,module in pairs({selfaff=Yso and Yso.selfaff,policy=Yso and Yso.curing and Yso.curing.policy}) do if type(module)=='table' and type(module.install_hooks)=='function' then for _,id in pairs(module._eh or {}) do if type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler,id) end end module._eh={};module._hooks_installed=false;module.install_hooks() end end end local function finish_job(job) if not R.busy or R.current~=job or not job.ack then return end local ok,why=R.idle();if not ok then fail(why);return end if normalize(getModulePath(job.name))~=normalize(staged(job.name)) then fail('module_path_mismatch:'..job.name);return end if read(staged(job.name))~=job.bytes then fail('module_input_changed:'..job.name);return end local configured,err=pcall(function() setModulePriority(job.name,job.priority) disableModuleSync(job.name) if job.name=='Yso system' then rearm_runtime() end end) if not configured then fail(job.name..':'..tostring(err));return end local saved,e=write(applied(job.name),job.bytes) if not saved then fail(job.name..':snapshot:'..tostring(e));return end cancel('timeout');R.current=nil later('operation',0.1,next_job) end next_job=function() if not R.busy then return end local ok,why=R.idle();if not ok then fail(why);return end R.index=R.index+1 local job=R.jobs[R.index] if not job then R.busy=false;R.last_result=R.action=='link' and 'linked' or 'reloaded';R.last_error=nil if R.previous_pause and Yso.pause and Yso.pause.offense and Yso.pause.offense.reason=='workspace_reload' then Yso.pause.offense.active=R.previous_pause.active;Yso.pause.offense.reason=R.previous_pause.reason or '' end say('AK and Yso '..R.last_result..' from the workspace. Combat automation remains stopped.') return end R.current=job if job.previous then local saved,e=write(home()..'/modules/'..job.name..'.previous.xml',job.previous) if not saved then fail(job.name..':previous_copy:'..tostring(e));return end end local saved,e=write(staged(job.name),job.bytes) if not saved then fail(job.name..':stage:'..tostring(e));return end later('timeout',20,function() -- Native deferred reloads cannot be cancelled by killing a Lua timer. -- Keep the operation, route guard and offense hold until its late ack arrives. R.last_error='waiting_for_native_module:'..job.name;R.last_result='waiting' say('Still waiting for '..job.name..'. Reload retries and offense remain blocked; use ysostatus. Restart the profile if no completion arrives.') end) local called,result,err=pcall(function() if job.was_package then uninstallPackage(job.name) if contains(getPackages(),job.name) then return false,'package_removal_failed' end end if job.was_module then return reloadModule(job.name) end return installModule(staged(job.name)) end) if not called or result==false or (result==nil and err~=nil) then fail(job.name..':'..tostring(called and err or result));return end -- Completion comes from sysInstall, including native module reloads. Its -- callback schedules the next step rather than nesting another install. end local function start(action) if R.busy then return false,'busy' end local jobs,why=preflight(action=='link') if not jobs then say('Update held: '..why);return false,why end if not (lfs and type(lfs.mkdir)=='function') then return false,'filesystem_api_unavailable' end for _,dir in ipairs({home(),home()..'/modules',home()..'/backups'}) do pcall(lfs.mkdir,dir) end R.busy=true;R.jobs=jobs;R.index=0;R.current=nil;R.action=action;R.last_error=nil hold_offense() if action~='link' then later('operation',0,next_job);return true end -- Verify a complete backup before the first existing package is removed. R.sequence=R.sequence+1 local filename='before-link-'..tostring(os.time())..'-'..R.sequence R.backup_path=home()..'/backups/'..filename..'.xml' local called,result,err=pcall(saveProfile,home()..'/backups',filename) if not called or result==false or (result==nil and err~=nil) then fail('profile_backup_failed');return false,'profile_backup_failed' end local attempts=0 local function await_backup() if not R.busy then return end attempts=attempts+1 if valid_xml(read(R.backup_path)) then later('operation',0.2,next_job) elseif attempts>=50 then fail('profile_backup_timeout') else later('operation',0.2,await_backup) end end later('operation',0.2,await_backup) return true end function R.link() return start('link') end function R.reload() return start('reload') end function R.check() local jobs,why=preflight(true) return jobs~=nil,why end
-- Reinstallation replaces the controller's own hooks; linked modules do not own them. for _,id in pairs(R.handlers) do if type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler,id) end end R.handlers={} for path in pairs(R.watches) do if type(removeFileWatch)=='function' then pcall(removeFileWatch,path) end end R.watches={} for key in pairs(R.timers) do cancel(key) end if type(getProfileName)~='function' or getProfileName()~='Achaea' then say('Disabled here: this workspace link belongs to the Achaea profile.') return R end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then R.handlers.install=registerAnonymousEventHandler('sysInstall',function(_,name,errors) local job=R.current if not (R.busy and job and job.name==name) then return end guard_routes() if type(errors)=='string' and errors~='' then fail(name..':'..errors);return end job.ack=true;later('operation',0.1,function() finish_job(job) end) end) R.handlers.changed=registerAnonymousEventHandler('sysPathChanged',function(_,path) local relevant=normalize(path)==normalize(R.root..'/Ysindrolir/mudlet packages') for _,name in ipairs(names) do relevant=relevant or normalize(path)==normalize(source(name)) end if not relevant then return end later('watch',0.75,function() -- Atomic file replacement can remove an individual watch; re-arm it. if type(addFileWatch)=='function' then for _,name in ipairs(names) do local p=source(name) if type(removeFileWatch)=='function' then pcall(removeFileWatch,p) end local ok=pcall(addFileWatch,p);if ok then R.watches[p]=true end end end if R.status(false).changed then say('Built workspace XML changed. Run ysoreload when automation is stopped (ysolink for first setup).') end end) end) end if type(addFileWatch)=='function' then for _,path in ipairs({source('AK'),source('Yso system'),R.root..'/Ysindrolir/mudlet packages'}) do local ok=pcall(addFileWatch,path);if ok then R.watches[path]=true end end end return R
